func (a *Application) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (a *mcpAuthorizer) Header(ctx context.Context) (string, error)

func (a *mcpAuthorizer) Unauthorized(ctx context.Context, status int, _ []string) error

func (b claimedWaitBackend) Claim(ctx context.Context) (func(), error)

func (m *mcpConnector) Authorize(ctx context.Context, server hub.MCPServer, open func(string) error) (product.MCPCredential, error)

func (m *mcpConnector) CredentialStatus(ctx context.Context, server hub.MCPServer) product.MCPCredential

func (m *mcpConnector) Probe(ctx context.Context, workspace string, server hub.MCPServer) product.MCPProbe

func (m *mcpConnector) Revoke(ctx context.Context, server hub.MCPServer) (product.MCPCredential, error)

func (r *companionSkillRepository) List(ctx context.Context) ([]skill.Skill, error)

func (r *companionSkillRepository) Load(ctx context.Context, name string) (skill.Document, error)

func (r *companionSkillRepository) Resource(ctx context.Context, name, relative string) (skill.Resource, error)

func (r *companionSkillRepository) Resources(ctx context.Context, name string) ([]string, error)

func (r *durableRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, input []wire.Message, emit func(abi.Event) error) error

func (r *durableRunner) WaitCheckpoint() *engine.WaitCheckpoint

func (r *ownedRunner) CleanupComplete() bool

func (r *ownedRunner) Close(ctx context.Context) error

func (r *ownedRunner) Run(ctx context.Context, messages []wire.Message, emit func(abi.Event) error) (err error)

func (r *ownedRunner) WaitCheckpoint() *engine.WaitCheckpoint

func (s *stderrTail) Record(_ context.Context, event mcpprotocol.IOEvent) (string, error)

func (s connectionDeveloperSource) Resolve(ctx context.Context, selected []eval.Target) ([]developer.Route, error)

func (s connectionDeveloperSource) Targets() []eval.Target

func LocalBindings(ctx context.Context, directory string) (storage.BindingStore, error)

func LocalMemory(ctx context.Context, directory string) (storage.MemoryStore, error)

func LocalStores(ctx context.Context, directory string) (Stores, error)

func Open(ctx context.Context, config Config) (application *Application, result error)

type Application struct {
	Store      ProductStorage
	Repository storage.Repository
	Runtime    *hub.Runtime
	Approvals  *host.ApprovalBroker
	Questions  *host.QuestionBroker
	Shells     *shell.Sessions
	Targets    []hub.Target
	Service    *product.HubService
}

type BindingsFactory func(context.Context, string) (storage.BindingStore, error)

type Config struct {
	OpenStores    StoresFactory
	OpenMemory    MemoryFactory
	OpenBindings  BindingsFactory
	DataDirectory string
	Demo          bool
	ProviderKind  provider.Kind
	Provider      provider.Config

	ImageCapable bool

	DeveloperRoutes       []developer.Route
	External              []ExternalEngine
	GitExecutable         string
	GitHostAccessApproved bool

	MCPVault keychain.Vault
}

type ExternalEngine struct {
	Vendor              string
	Command             string
	PrefixArgs          []string
	Env                 map[string]string
	Transport           string
	CodexSandbox        string
	CodexApprovalPolicy string

	CLIConfigDirectory string
	ApprovedHostAccess bool
}

type MemoryFactory func(context.Context, string) (storage.MemoryStore, error)

type ProductStorage interface {
	hub.Store
	hub.WaitStore
	hub.ToolSettingsStore
	hub.TeamStore
	hub.WorkerDraftStore
	hub.AutomationStore
	hub.WorktreeStore
	hub.NativeOwnerResolver
	hub.PreferencesStore
	hub.AppSettingsStore
	hub.ConnectionsStore
	hub.GoalStore
	hub.CompanionStore
	hub.WorkspaceViewStore
	hub.DeveloperRepositoryStore
	hub.ConversationTabStore
	hub.ConversationTabAdmissionStore
	hub.SessionModelOptionsStore
	hub.ComposerDraftStore
	hub.ComposerFileStore
	hub.ComposerFileOwnershipStore
	hub.ComposerDraftAdmissionStore
	hub.ComposerExecutionStore
	Close() error
}

type Stores struct {
	Product  ProductStorage
	Sessions storage.Repository
}

type StoresFactory func(context.Context, string) (Stores, error)
